chunks: Sa'd, from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, who said: Some of our companions narrated to me, saying: I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام...
about the salat of al-Fitr and al-Adha. So he said: Pray them as two rak'ahs, in congregation and outside congregation, and say the takbir five and seven times.

key_terms.الْأَضْحَى: the Eid of al-Adha prayer context

ai.seo_question: How should Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha salat be performed according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the salat of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that they are to be performed as two rak'ahs, whether in congregation or individually, with prescribed takbirs of five and seven.
